purpose: Audit partner-ranking rules for manual-bet mode using the deployed Ability v1, M3 core and P10 models reconstructed from strictly prior TARGET histories.
universe: JRA flat, field_size>=12, 3-win class or higher; complete 2025-2026 result races available in the uploaded TARGET exports
eligible_axis_definition: Exactly one M3 Top3 x Ability Top3 structural horse; axis Ability rank 1 or 2; final-popularity proxy 1-6; Ability1 also P10<50%. Final popularity is used only as a historical proxy for the current market-eligibility gate.
candidate_rules_compared: Ability rank + M3 rank + P10 risk penalty
reason: Ability-only partner ordering was materially stronger and more stable than the combined Borda-style rules. M3, main-scenario rank and P10 should remain explanatory/risk traits instead of moving the core partner order until a separately frozen OOS combiner proves incremental value.

ui_policy.partner_rank: Order non-axis horses by Ability rank only.
ui_policy.core_partners: Partner ranks 1-2 are CORE for quinella/wide review; rank 3 is BACKUP.
ui_policy.trio_pool: Use Ability partner ranks 1-3 as the primary three-horse opponent pool; rank 4 adds only about 1.1 percentage points in this retrospective audit.
ui_policy.m3_p10_scenario: Display as traits/risk/context, not as ranking weights.
ui_policy.market: Display popularity and price as downstream reference only; do not use them to reorder partners.

caveats: This is a retrospective reconstruction using final popularity as a proxy for the axis 1-6 popularity gate because exact T-15 historical snapshots are unavailable.
Partner ordering itself is market-independent and uses strictly prior histories, but price/ROI of the new Ability-ranked pair choices is not established by this audit.
Main-scenario rank was deliberately excluded from the selected ranking because no separately frozen OOS incremental partner-ranking gain has yet been established.
Forward logging remains required before any pair-price rule is promoted to a green buy rule.
